    Methods

    Every assembly was tiled into non-overlapping 10 kb bins over chr21. Each bin is represented by the set of its canonical 31-mers whose splitmix64 hash falls below 2⁶⁴/200 (a FracMinHash sketch, so every assembly independently keeps the same ~1/200 sample of k-mer space). Bins with fewer than 5 retained hashes, or with less than 50% unambiguous bases, were dropped.

    k-mers were kept when present in at least 5% of samples and in at least 2 bins, then deterministically sub-sampled to at most 200,000 features. The resulting sparse bin × k-mer matrix was weighted with idf and l2 row normalisation, then factored by randomized SVD into 64 components (7 power iterations, 20 oversamples).

    Components were embedded with UMAP (n_neighbors=30, min_dist=0.05, cosine metric, 2D) and clustered with hdbscan in the embedding space (min_cluster_size=50, min_samples=10, eom selection). A bin counts as carrying a feature when the feature covers at least 25% of it; enrichment is the log2 ratio of that rate inside a cluster to the genome-wide rate, with a hypergeometric survival-function p-value.

    Every random choice in the pipeline derives from seed 7; the report itself sub-samples with seed 7. plotly.js is loaded from the CDN because report.embed_plotlyjs is false, so this file needs network access to draw its plots.

    Caveats for this particular run: The heatmap shows the 60 largest of 559 clusters.
